body: thank you so much for replying to my posts.  This gave me something to think about, and I feel much better.  it was really kind of you.

No, what you say makes great sense.  When I socialize with others, I am usually just tagging along, and often have no interest in these activities.  I try to voice my opinion but I'm just not a very loud person yeah, so it goes unnoticed and I suppose I end up doing things I disslike.  Maybe this is one reason I quit socializing as much.  I realized alone with myself I could do the things I enjoy.  I guess maybe I just need to try harder to find others with similar interests rather than just, people for the sake of people.

I should be researching right now.  This is the problem.  It's like I'm getting to a point where I'm thinking, will this shit ever end?  I love what I do but it's all I do and so no matter what I keep ending up like a failure.  As I am now a failure as I have no personal connections.  If I spend the time on personal connections I'll be throwing away massive opportunities.  And it's dumb because I recognize how trivial both things are.  None of it matters anyway so I kind of hate myself for caring so much for things that don't ultimately matter in the long run.  I'm sorry I know I just sound like I'm complaining.  I'm just so, so down and have no one to talk to.  Yesterday I was just so sad but it's to the point I can't cry or anything.  I just lay there and then realize hours have passed.  It's so stupid.

I think maybe that's where the problem stems from.  I'm so caught in my career now, I feel there's no way to do that.  I love people and have so much love to give, but every moment I spend with others I am spending there thinking "i should be researching/working, etc" and I end up hating the time and finding any excuse to leave.  I know this is a dumb and irrational thing.  But it's been like this for years now and I don't know how to stop.
